messages:
Maya L: Starting rollout of the CRM guided-scan playbook — will mark stale accounts and trigger manual touch workflow + auto-tagging. Scheduled tonight 02:00 PST for canary.
Jake T: Quick q — what's the definition of 'stale' here? 90 days since last activity?
Maya L: Default is 90d, but we'll use 60d for high-touch segments (enterprise, pilot). Config snippet:
```yaml
scan:
  stale_days: 60
  segments: [enterprise, pilot]
  actions:
    - tag: 'stale_auto'
    - notify: 'cs-touch'
```
Ravi P: If tags misfire what's rollback?
Maya L: We have an undo job: `csops-playbook undo --scan-id scan-1923456789`. Also webhook suppression flag for 30m while we validate. Do not escalate unless >5% false positives.
Sophia K: I'll run a dry-run on staging export now and post results in 30m.
CSOps-Bot: scheduled_scan created id=scan-1923456789 dry_run=true eta=30m
Onboard-Bot: owner_notify dispatched count=42 (dry_run)
Jake T: Can we exclude accounts with open renewal opportunities >30 days to avoid churn risk contacts?
Maya L: Good call — adding exclude_renewal_days: 30 and pushing patch now.
Maya L: Deploy plan: canary 10% (enterprise owners) for 1h -> monitor healthscore delta + inbound NPS flags -> if ok, ramp to 100%.
Sophia K: Monitoring healthscore dashboard, will flag if >5% drop or >3 NPS complaints :eyes:
Jake T: LGTM :thumbsup:
Maya L: Thanks — will update here with dry-run summary + final rollout ts.
